verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's official docs show it runs headless as a self-operated conversion engine. It offers batch `--convert-to` conversion with export filters, and a headless mode meant for control by external clients via the API. UNO acceptor strings let it serve as a listening API endpoint. A community user independently confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize formats. Missing for 10: no first-party container image or deployment guide, no documented embeddable-library packaging, and thin documentation of the UNO server/listener setup beyond a one-line parameter description.
